state_failure_version_rules: This is an L1 draft design contract: no compiled public consumer, BP execution, L2 integration or capability completion is asserted by this file.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Move nodes 4 and 5 by (0,1,0)mm changes exactly two records in one commit; one undo restores both.
Cancelled preview increments no revision and leaves committed model intact.
Outdated selection/candidate revision rejects; quality failures cannot partially apply.
Operation semantics/version and complete reverse deltas are recorded in persistent history.
